tool.desc.accessibility: Check the document, edit its structure tags, and fix the reading order.
tool.desc.actions: Save sequences of steps and run them on a document with one click.
tool.desc.attachments: Embed, extract, and remove attached files.
tool.desc.comment: Highlight, add text boxes, draw, stamp — and review every comment in the document.
tool.desc.compare: See what changed between two documents.
tool.desc.edit: Edit text, whole paragraphs, and images — or add new text — right on the page.
tool.desc.export: Pull the text out of a document, and check its tables before they become a spreadsheet.
tool.desc.fillsign: Fill in a form and sign it, or verify a signature.
tool.desc.headerfooter: Add headers, footers, page numbers, and Bates numbering.
tool.desc.layers: Show or hide the document’s optional-content layers.
tool.desc.links: Draw link regions, target them at a page, a file or an address, and style their borders.
tool.desc.measure: Measure distances, perimeters, and areas on the page.
tool.desc.ocr: Scan pages from a scanner, straighten and clean them, then make them searchable.
tool.desc.optimize: Reduce file size, convert to grayscale or PDF/A.
tool.desc.organize: Reorder, rotate, delete, split, extract — and merge pages between open files.
tool.desc.pagebox: Crop pages and edit the crop/bleed/trim/art boxes.
tool.desc.pagelabels: Number pages as i/ii/iii, 1/2/3, A/B/C, with prefixes.
tool.desc.portfolio: Create a PDF portfolio and manage its member files.
tool.desc.prepareform: Detect the fields on a flat form, or add and edit them by hand, then flatten.
tool.desc.printproduction: Preview separations and ink coverage, manage inks, check print readiness, and convert colour.
tool.desc.redact: Mark text to remove — by hand, or by searching every occurrence — then permanently strip it from the file.
tool.desc.repair: Validate a damaged file and rebuild it, in escalating tiers.
tool.desc.snapshot: Copy a region of the page to the clipboard as a picture.
tool.desc.takeoff: Count items on a drawing by group, then export the takeoff or place a legend.
